placements.why: Both expressions ratify and specify a structural contract governing how remember executes — immediate dispatch, receipt issuance, and async completion tracking — which is organizational-architecture-grain content with no existing strata category to hold it.
placements.title: System behavior is fixed at the level of dispatch and completion contracts, not just features
placements.frame: Does this content name a structural guarantee about how the system executes and completes work, rather than a feature or a one-time result?

placements.title: remember shifts from a synchronous call to an async dispatch that returns a receipt and defers completion
placements.frame: When remember is invoked, what is actually being guaranteed to the caller — an immediate receipt with no blocking, or the mechanism (poll vs. piggyback) by which the deferred extraction result eventually surfaces?
placements.why: src-1 ratifies the contract as a concrete caller-facing guarantee (receipt in seconds, no blocking call, no lost work) and src-2 restates it as the operational choreography the agent follows (dispatch, then poll or piggyback) — both are the same directional theme of remember as async-dispatch-with-deferred-completion, a subject future envelopes about this contract will keep feeding, not a one-time fact.
